title: Economics and Management of Community Development

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of community and community development, including goals, motivations, economic and resource management, institutions, and project management.
Apply project management techniques to community development projects.
Analyze economic factors in community development.
Manage resources effectively for community development.
Develop leadership skills to mobilize community resources and engage stakeholders.
Conduct research and analyze data relevant to community development.
Communicate effectively to engage community members and stakeholders.
Work effectively in teams to achieve community development goals.
Apply critical thinking to solve community development challenges.
Engage community members in development processes.
